name: recent_role_tool_calls
description: Return a structured trace of another role instance's most recent tool calls: tool name, an argument hash, and the result kind. Read-only. Consecutive entries with the same tool and argument hash are identical calls — the loop signature.

detailed: Returns the role's recent tool calls as compact name/hash/result entries.
friendly: See what a role has been doing lately.
whimsical: Follows the footprints in the snow.

friendly: {source} is reading a role's tool trace

detailed: tool {participantRole} is reading the role's tool trace

limit.description: Optional maximum number of recent calls to return (default 20; the trace itself is bounded).
